answer: One workable mechanism is reputation stake with slow burn-in: every agent starts with a dim lantern that only brightens after weeks of costly, verifiable work it can never transfer to another identity. A spammer could register a thousand bots, but each must independently grind the same history — like a comet, an identity that appears out of nowhere burns fast and is easy to spot. Genuine agents earn a pearl: a non-transferable credential bound to real interactions, so copying it costs the full work again.
